note: Draft 1. 26 items, 9 unknown words (iniquidades, imputou (mended), impiedade, exultação, mulo, cabresto, queixadas (mended), flagelos, gloriai-vos). Two wrong first hearings mended: 31:5b 'Confessarei contra mim a minha injustiça' as an injustice done to me (→ the stylist's order), 31:9b 'apertai as queixadas deles' as an order to the congregation (→ 'Senhor,' named). Heard rightly: 31:1 'cobertos' as forgiven, 31:6 'Por isto' as 'because God forgave', 31:7 'ó minha exultação' as said to God, 31:8 the Lord speaking (unannounced, as the Latin), 31:8 'firmarei sobre ti os meus olhos' as care, 31:9 'Não vos torneis' as said to the community, 31:11 'gloriai-vos' as joyful celebration. Kept as the Latin's: 31:4 'voltei-me' heard as turning to God first (convértere's own range; 'revolvi-me' the option), 31:6 'todo santo' as the canonized first (ὅσιος; as 30:24), 31:6b 'dele' needing the verse before.

outcomes.remark: 'contra mim' may attach to 'injustiça' (an injustice against me)
'apertai' heard as an order to the community (the vós of 31:9)
'voltei-me' heard as turning to God first
outcomes.reason: convértere → voltar (glossary); the Latin's own word carries both; 'revolvi-me' (MS1932, the tossing) is the option.
The Latin's word (ὅσιος) either way; 'cada santo' and MS1932's 'todo homem santo' are options.
The familiar pair 'cabresto e freio' (MS1932); 'focinheira' is the option.
